problems.title: List Length
problems.description: Return the number of nodes in a singly linked list. Inputs use the pipe-separated notation shown in the examples for parameters or multiple lists. Values are integers and output values must be separated by single spaces.
problems.input_format: The input is a whitespace- or pipe-separated record; the examples show the exact token order and list boundaries.
problems.output_format: Print the requested value or linked-list sequence on one line.
problems.constraints: 1 <= list length <= 100000; -1000000000 <= node value <= 1000000000; parameters are valid.
hints: Use a dummy node when an operation may change the head.
For two-ended operations, compare a forward traversal with a reversed or fast/slow traversal.
